vulnerabilities.title: Hardcoded Secret
vulnerabilities.description: Hardcoded credential found in variable/property 'passwordQuestion'. Secrets in source code can be extracted by anyone with access to the repository.
vulnerabilities.snippet:
{
		const string passwordQuestion = "What is your favorite color";
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Store secrets in environment variables, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or a secure configuration provider. Never commit secrets to source control.

vulnerabilities.title: Logging Sensitive Data
vulnerabilities.description: Potentially sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII) being written to logs.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Never log sensitive data. Mask or redact sensitive fields before logging. Use structured logging with data classification.

vulnerabilities.title: Deprecated Encryption Class
vulnerabilities.description: RijndaelManaged is deprecated. While AES is a subset of Rijndael, use the Aes class directly.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Replace RijndaelManaged with Aes.Create() for clarity and to ensure AES-compliant block sizes.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.description: SQL query constructed with string concatenation or interpolation using potentially untrusted input.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or stored procedures. For Dapper, use @param placeholders with anonymous objects.

vulnerabilities.title: Timing Attack Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: String comparison used for security-sensitive values. Standard string comparison short-circuits on first difference, leaking timing information.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals() for comparing security-sensitive byte arrays (hashes, tokens, HMACs).

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Deserialization
vulnerabilities.description: BinaryFormatter is inherently unsafe and can lead to remote code execution when deserializing untrusted data.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Do not use BinaryFormatter. Use System.Text.Json or JsonSerializer with known types. BinaryFormatter is obsolete and marked dangerous by Microsoft.

vulnerabilities.title: Open Redirect
vulnerabilities.description: Redirect to user-controlled URL. Attacker could redirect users to a malicious site for phishing.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use Url.IsLocalUrl() to validate redirect targets. Only allow redirects to relative URLs or a whitelist of trusted domains.

vulnerabilities.title: XML External Entity (XXE) Risk
vulnerabilities.description: XmlDocument created without disabling DTD processing or setting XmlResolver to null.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: For XmlDocument, set XmlResolver = null and/or DtdProcessing = DtdProcessing.Prohibit immediately after creation.
